test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two trains, 259 m and 231 m in length, are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 55 km/hr and the second at the rate of 71 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction → speeds add

Total distance = 259 + 231 = 490 m

Relative speed = (55 + 71) = 126 km/hr = 126 × 5/18 = 35 m/s

Time = 490 ÷ 35 = 14 sec

**∴ Answer = 14 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of first train = 259 m, second train = 231 m

Speed of first = 55 km/hr, second = 71 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 259 + 231 = 490 m

⇒ Relative speed = 55 + 71 = 126 km/hr

⇒ Convert speed: 126 × 5/18 = 35 m/s

⇒ Time = 490 ÷ 35 = 14 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 14 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction → speeds add, Same direction → speeds subtract.

Train Crossing Rule

When two trains cross, distance = sum of their lengths.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s → multiply by 5/18.

Basic Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Speed
